title: Create a Scene and open the Editor from New Scene

claims.statement: Claude Code (claude-code) is the source-producing agent for CHG-0056 under human principal @rodrigoteamx, on the 2026-08-24 directive to complete the Studio New Scene wiring node. This does not authorize automatic merge of CHG-0056.
claims.evidence: AGENTS.md, profile.json actors and the 2026-08-24 user directive.

claims.statement: CHG-0055 added the Show-scoped create-Scene endpoint but deferred the Studio wiring; the Studio Scenes surface routed New Scene directly to a blank Editor without creating a Scene, so no independent Scene was created on choosing New.
claims.evidence: studio/src/views/ScenesView.vue before this change routed New scene to /shows/:id/new-scene, and CHG-0055 deferred unknown.

claims.statement: The fix changes the Studio Scenes surface's New Scene control to call POST /api/shows/:showId/scenes and open the Editor on the created Scene, so choosing New Scene creates a new independent Scene in the Show and opens it in the Editor, and the Scene then appears on the Scenes surface.

Governed discovery reordered the node: with the unified storage and the Show-scoped create-Scene endpoint already in place from CHG-0055, the UI half of AC-006 is a small Scenes surface change plus a browser proof.
claims.evidence: Governed-discovery reorder check on 2026-08-24 and CHG-0055.

claims.statement: Routing New Scene through the create endpoint and asserting the Editor opens on the created Scene, which then appears on the Scenes surface, proves AC-006's browser-tier create-and-open behavior without a Template chooser.

Human review accepted CHG-0056: choosing New Scene on the Studio Scenes surface creates a new independent Scene in the Show through the create endpoint and opens the Editor on it, and the Scene appears on the Scenes surface (AC-006 UI half), proven in a real browser. Template creation and Scene-id scoping stay deferred.
claims.evidence: studio/src/views/ScenesView.vue, server/tests/e2e/studioNewScene.test.ts (fails before the wiring, passes after), the passing Studio unit suite and full server suite under npm run check, the CHG-0056 pull-request Constitution run (all eight jobs), and human acceptance on 2026-08-24.

claims.statement: The change is a twenty-five-line Studio Scenes surface edit; no server or protocol behavior changes and the OBS proof continues to skip where OBS is absent.
claims.evidence: git diff of the CHG-0056 branch and the pull-request validate job.

claims.statement: Template-based Scene creation (choosing a Template rather than blank) is not implemented; only blank creation is wired.
claims.evidence: studio/src/views/ScenesView.vue createScene creates a blank named Scene only.

claims.statement: The create-Scene endpoint derives the Scene id from the name slug, so two Shows with a same-named Scene would share an id; a Show-scoped or unique Scene id is a deferred follow-on.
claims.evidence: server/src/routes/collections.ts create-Scene route uses slug(name) for the id.

successCriteria.statement: Choosing New Scene on the Studio Scenes surface creates a Scene in the Show and navigates to the Editor on that Scene (AC-006).
successCriteria.verification: Browser harness clicks New scene and asserts the Editor edit route and the Edit-scene surface.

successCriteria.statement: The created Scene appears on the Show's Scenes surface.
successCriteria.verification: Browser harness returns to the Scenes surface and asserts the created Scene is listed.

successCriteria.statement: No existing Studio or server behavior regresses.
successCriteria.verification: The Studio unit suite and the full server suite pass.

definitionOfDone.statement: CHG-0056 records the New Scene wiring and the deferred Template creation and Scene-id scoping before implementation.
definitionOfDone.evidence: Schema-valid record and deterministic governance compilation.

definitionOfDone.statement: The Studio Scenes surface's New Scene control creates a Scene through the create endpoint and opens the Editor on it.
A browser test proves create-and-open and that the Scene appears; the Studio unit suite and full server suite pass.
Governance, licensing, lint, type-check, focused and full tests, build, dependency audit and diff checks pass before handoff.
definitionOfDone.evidence: npm run governance:check, npm run check, npm run build, npm audit (0 vulnerabilities), ESLint, vue-tsc and git diff --check; the accept commit is verified by its own pull-request Constitution run before merge.
